steps.name: Given the user opens the browser
And navigates to the Flipkart homepage
And closes any login popup if displayed
When the user enters "Samsung Galaxy S24" into the search bar
And clicks on the search button
Then the page title should contain "Samsung"
And the search results header should display "Samsung Galaxy S24"
